  PROBLEM: The PR description/title claims to swap `z-ai/glm-5` for `mistralai/codestral-2508` in the active reviewer panel, but the actual implementation only updates the catalog description and does not enable codestral.
  WHY: The PR's stated intent is not reflected in the code, so reviewers still run on GLM-5.
- agents.md:83-85 and 107-110 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]

  WHY: The documentation can confuse which models are actually in the active reviewer panel versus merely catalogued.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:96-102 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `REVIEWER_MODELS` block still lists `z-ai/glm-5` and does not include `mistralai/codestral-2508`, so the active reviewer panel was not swapped as the PR description/title claimed.
  WHY: The cost-saving objective of the PR is unfulfilled because the workflow still dispatches reviews to GLM-5.
